capital.evidence_quote: St. George's is the capital and largest city of the Caribbean island nation of Grenada

currency.evidence_quote: The Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD) is pegged to the USD at 2.70 XCD to 1 USD; USD is widely accepted

timezone.evidence_quote: Grenada operates on Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 year-round without seasonal changes

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Grenada and Carriacou is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The operating frequency of the electrical network is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets in Grenada exclusively accept British standard Type G rectangular three-pin plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police response throughout Grenada

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 434 for ambulance dispatch and emergency medical assistance

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency fire and rescue operations

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Police headquarters in St. George's handles tourist assistance at +1 473 440-2244

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Grenada dünyanın en güvenli ve huzurlu ada ülkelerindendir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Grenada is very safe and tranquil; exercise standard travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Grenada ist ein sehr friedliches und sicheres Karibikland; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Гренада — спокойный и безопасный остров пряностей; действуют обычные правила.
advisory_headline.es: Granada es un destino caribeño sumamente pacífico y seguro; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Grenada reach approximately 39.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Grenada measure 75.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel and Flow offer 4G tourist SIMs at Maurice Bishop International Airport (GND). Grenada is nicknamed the 'Spice Isle' producing world-renowned nutmeg, cinnamon, and cloves.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid cellular packages are available for visitors with passport identification

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 86%, predominantly Roman Catholic, Anglican, and Seventh-day Adventist)
religion.evidence_quote: Catholicism and Protestantism represent the spiritual core of Grenadian community life

festivals.value: Spicemas Carnival (August - famous for Jab Jab morning masquerade), Carriacou Regatta, Grenada Chocolate Fest
festivals.evidence_quote: Spicemas is Grenada's premier cultural carnival culminating in J'ouvert Jab Jab traditions

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage patterns or military-style gear is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists. Swimming or walking in swimwear away from beaches into downtown St. George's is considered offensive. British Type G plugs are used.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Wearing camouflage pattern clothing is prohibited by law under penalty of fine or confiscation

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included on restaurant and hotel bills; leaving an extra 5-10% for waitstaff is customary.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% service charge is customary in dining establishments
